title: MemoryBackend mints identical Category ids
description: memory.rs apply_category_op AddCategory uses demo_next_id(inner, "Category", ..), which counts objects_ref("Category"). Categories are never stored there, so every category in every Space is given id category0000000000000001. As a result updateCategories/removeCategories cannot address any category but the first by id. Draft Space/set addCategories says 'Server assigns ULIDs', so the ids must be unique. Found during JMAP-yt1w.6; that item's tests seed distinct ids directly to work around it.
notes: Done in b91f9544: tests space_set_category_add_assigns_unique_ids; changed existing tests: none
